system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

| #### Crimson Pact / Fortitude Amp / You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits; / Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions. / Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute. / Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points. |

You shower the battlefield in your ichor, baptizing everything in blood. While you have your Ketsuryugan active, you can, spend 1 action to build your Crimson Domain. You can use this feature once per long rest.

When you do, you radiate chakra and blood droplets a 40-foot radius, centered on you, for the next minute. For the duration you gain the following;

Creatures with ranks of Bleed that are in the radius, that would regain hit points, instead regains half of the listed amount. You gain the remaining half.

Creatures with ranks of Bleed that begin their turn in this radius must move at least 30 feet, fully circulating their own blood, or they lose their Reaction until the beginning of their next turn.

When an allied creature gains hit points or temporary hit points, you can select one other allied or willing creature and they gain half of the hit points or temporary hit points gained.

When a creature with 2 or more ranks of Bleed would move into a space not within your domain, you can spend your Reaction, to reduce their remaining speed to 0, and then they must move 15 feet closer to you.
